TIPS TO REQUEST
RECYCLING AT
YOUR APARTMENT
If you currently do not have recycling at your complex,
here are some steps that you can take to request it.
SPEAK TO YOUR LANDLORD
It’s likely that your landlord knows how to get
recycling at your complex. Speaking with them
may help you learn exactly what is needed. It’s
important to let your landlord know residents are
interested in having recycling services.

TIPS TO REQUEST
RECYCLING AT
YOUR APARTMENT

If you currently do not have recycling at your complex,
here are some steps that you can take to request it.
SPEAK TO YOUR LANDLORD
It’s likely that your landlord knows how to get
recycling at your complex. Speaking with them
may help you learn exactly what is needed. It’s
important to let your landlord know residents are
interested in having recycling services.

GATHER SUPPORT FROM YOUR
NEIGHBORS
Explain to your neighbors what is needed to get
recycling in your complex. Ask them if they will

sign a petition for it. Your landlord is more likely
to pay attention when multiple residents want
recycling services.
RESEARCH RECYCLING COSTS
Find out or ask your landlord to research how much
recycling haulers in your area would charge to
service your complex and ask for an estimate. Be
ready to provide them the number of units in your
complex.
PRESENT YOUR FINDINGS TO
YOUR LANDLORD

Set up an appointment with your landlord. Present
them with the signatures you’ve gathered and the
research you did on recycling costs. Make sure you
provide a few options for recycling haulers, along
with evidence of widespread interest.

RECYCLING EDUCATION
If your landlord approves of the plan, it will be
important to educate the residents on how to
recycle right. The Zero Waste team offers
recycling presentations. You can request them by
filling out the form on phoenix.gov/zerowaste
